items.followUp: What is an enzyme, and what role does it perform in a cell?

rubric.why: Identifies the biological nature of enzymes.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying enzymes as proteins.

rubric.why: States the function that defines enzymes.
rubric.description: States that enzymes act as biological catalysts and speed up reactions.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that enzymes catalyse or speed up biochemical reactions.

modelAnswer: Enzymes are proteins that act as biological catalysts.
They speed up chemical reactions in living organisms.
